discovery: Development of next-generation (massively parallel sequencing-by-synthesis) DNA sequencing
rationale: Solexa/Illumina sequencing-by-synthesis, built on fluorescent reversible-terminator chemistry and cluster amplification, cut genome sequencing costs by orders of magnitude and changed biology and medicine. It is chemistry-based, mature and widely used, and its inventors have already won major precursor awards (Millennium Technology Prize 2020, Breakthrough Prize 2022). That fits the committee's recent pattern of rewarding chemistry tools with broad impact. Recent prizes went to MOFs, protein design, quantum dots and click chemistry, which leaves this area open.
